lessons.title: अंदाजपत्रक आणि मर्यादा
lessons.learn: Planning speaks in conditions and obligations: खर्च वाढल्यास …, प्रत्येक टप्प्याला मर्यादा ठरवावी लागेल. The formal conditional is -ल्यास, the spoken one is तर, and obligation uses the -ावी/-ावे form with लागेल, agreeing with its noun. Marathi keeps the obligation impersonal, so the person is named only when it matters.

grammar.title: Condition and obligation
grammar.pattern: खर्च वाढल्यास … · मर्यादा ठरवावी लागेल · तरतूद ठेवली आहे
grammar.explain: -ल्यास is the formal if (वाढल्यास, झाल्यास) and closes its own clause; तर is the spoken one and follows it. Obligation takes -ावी/-ावे with लागेल, and it agrees with its noun: मर्यादा ठरवावी लागेल, खर्च ठरवावा लागेल, काम करावे लागेल.

examples.en: If the cost rises, the deadline will have to be extended.
A limit will have to be fixed for each stage.
A provision has been kept for this.

mistakes.why: Obligation takes the -ावी form: ठरवावी लागेल.

mistakes.wrong: खर्च वाढला तर मुदत वाढेल लागेल.
mistakes.why: One obligation frame, not two futures stacked.

dialogue.t: या वर्षीचे अंदाजपत्रक तयार आहे का?
dialogue.r: Ya varshicha andaajpatrak tayar ahe ka?
dialogue.en: Is this year's budget ready?

dialogue.t: तयार आहे, पण दोन टप्प्यांना मर्यादा ठरवावी लागेल.
dialogue.r: Tayar ahe, pan don tappyanna maryada tharvavi lagel.
dialogue.en: It is ready, but a limit will have to be fixed for two stages.
If the cost rises, what is to be done?

dialogue.t: तेव्हा मुदत वाढवावी लागेल किंवा कामकाज कमी करावे लागेल.
dialogue.r: Tevha mudat vaadhavi lagel kinva kamkaj kami karave lagel.

lessons.title: वाटाघाटी आणि तडजोड
lessons.learn: A negotiation leaves room inside the sentence: या दरात पुरवठा करता येईल. The potential -ता येईल makes an offer without promising it, a refusal names what is impossible rather than the person, and तडजोडीची तयारी states readiness. A counter-offer usually opens with थोडे or पण, so that the door stays open.

grammar.title: Softening and refusing
grammar.pattern: करता येईल · इतक्यात शक्य नाही · तडजोडीची तयारी आहे
grammar.explain: The potential -ता येईल (करता, देता, घेता) offers without committing. A refusal names the impossible: इतक्यात शक्य नाही. Readiness takes the -ची possessive of what one is ready for — तडजोडीची तयारी, बोलणीची तयारी.

examples.en: Supply can be made at this rate.

examples.t: इतक्यात शक्य नाही, पण विचार करता येईल.
examples.r: Itkyat shakya nahi, pan vichaar karta yeil.
examples.en: It is not possible at that rate, but it can be considered.

mistakes.why: The potential takes the -ता stem: देता येईल, करता येईल.
तयारी takes -ची of what one is ready for.

lessons.title: अहवाल आणि आढावा
lessons.learn: A report names its finding impersonally: अहवालात नमूद केले आहे की …, and it keeps what is pending visible with बाकी आहेत. आढावा घेणे is the verb for holding a review, and the passive जाईल announces the next step without naming who takes it. A reported clause always takes की.

grammar.title: Reporting a finding
grammar.pattern: अहवालात नमूद केले आहे की … · पडताळणीच्या बाकी आहेत · आढावा घेतला जाईल
grammar.explain: A reported clause takes की. नमूद केले आहे and म्हटले आहे keep the writer out of the sentence, and बाकी agrees with what is pending (मुद्दे बाकी आहेत). The passive जाईल announces the next step, and तपासले आहे reports what is already done.

examples.t: अहवालात नमूद केले आहे की खर्च अंदाजापेक्षा जास्त आहे.
examples.r: Ahavalat namud kele ahe ki kharch andaajapeksha jaast ahe.
examples.en: The report states that the cost is higher than estimated.
Two points are still pending verification.
The review will be held next month.

mistakes.why: मुद्दे is plural, so it takes आहेत.

mistakes.wrong: अहवालात नमूद केले आहे खर्च वाढला.
mistakes.right: अहवालात नमूद केले आहे की खर्च वाढला.

culture.text: Marathi is the official language of Maharashtra and one of India's 22 scheduled languages, with roughly 83 million speakers. The state was redrawn on language lines in 1960, and the Marathi-speaking belt runs past its border — Belagavi and the Goa coast included — which is why a Marathi speaker may be in Karnataka or Goa as naturally as in Pune. In the courts, the collector's office and the municipal corporation, Marathi and English share the page, and the negotiating vocabulary is mostly Marathi words doing English work.

reading.text: दोन्ही बाजूंनी कराराच्या अटी वाचल्या. पुरवठादाराने मुदत तीन महिन्यांची मागितली, पण आमच्या बाजूने खर्च वाढणार होता. बोलणी दोन तास चालली. शेवटी एक तडजोड झाली: पहिला टप्पा दोन महिन्यांत, दुसरा टप्पा चार महिन्यांत. दोन्ही बाजूंनी अटी लिखित स्वरूपात मान्य केल्या आणि करारावर स्वाक्षरी केली. कोंडी फुटली कारण दोन्ही बाजूंनी अंतिम मुदत वाढवायला तयारी दाखवली. पुढील बैठकीत दररोजच्या पुरवठ्याचा आढावा घ्यायचे ठरले.
reading.gloss: Both sides read the terms of the contract. The supplier asked for a three-month deadline, but on our side the cost was going to rise. The talks went on for two hours. In the end there was a compromise: the first stage in two months, the second in four. Both sides accepted the conditions in writing and signed the contract. The deadlock broke because both sides showed readiness to extend the final deadline. At the next meeting it was decided to review the daily supply.

listening.script:
वकील: मुदतीवर दोन्ही बाजूंनी ठरले आहे का?
सल्लागार: ठरले आहे, पण अट एक आहे — पहिला टप्पा दोन महिन्यांत.
वकील: ती अट कागदावर लिहिली पाहिजे, अन्यथा पुढे वाद होईल.
सल्लागार: तयार आहे. मी आज सायंकाळी मसुदा पाठवतो.
वकील: चांगले. मसुद्यात दोन्ही बाजूंची स्वाक्षरी आणि दिनांक ठेवा.
listening.gloss: Lawyer: Have both sides settled on the deadline? Advisor: It is settled, but there is one condition — the first stage within two months. Lawyer: That condition must be written on paper, otherwise there will be a dispute later. Advisor: Ready. I will send the draft this evening. Lawyer: Good. Put both signatures and the date in the draft.

idioms.meaning: to resolve a tangle or a dispute
to pave the way for something

mistakes.why: अट is feminine, so the verb follows it: अट मान्य केली, अटी मान्य केल्या.
वाटाघाटी is plural: वाटाघाटी सुरू आहेत, वाटाघाटी तडकल्या.
मान्य आहे describes the contract; accepting it needs the verb मान्य करतो / करते.

task.title: Draft the minutes of a negotiation
task.instructions: Write five Marathi sentences of minutes: who met, what each side asked for, the तडजोड that was reached, the अट that was written down, and the signature line with a date. Use the impersonal once (ठरवले गेले) and keep the verbs in the polite form.
